constraints: The entry order within a subform is not returned when this command is applied to the parent form.
The actual entry order (the * variant) always includes objects from page 0 and inherited form(s).

overloadMerges.note: objectNames is filled by the command (parameter table arrow '←'), so its direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.name: objectNames
params.description: Filled with the object names sorted by declared entry order; empty if FORM SET ENTRY ORDER was never called for the current form

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page for which to get the declared entry order; current page if omitted

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the entry order previously declared for the current or given page via FORM SET ENTRY ORDER (empty if never declared).

overloadMerges.note: objectNames is filled by the command (parameter table arrow '←'), so its direction should be 'out'.

params.name: objectNames
params.description: Filled with only the valid object names making up the actual, in-effect entry order of the current page
If passed, return the actual entry order currently in effect (default layering order, Form editor order, or a prior FORM SET ENTRY ORDER call) instead of only what was explicitly declared

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the actual, currently effective entry order of the current page, regardless of whether FORM SET ENTRY ORDER was ever called.
